company.name: GAIA
company.shortDescription: GAIA helps to empower human capacity, enhance quality of living and collaborate effectively with communities.
company.description: GAIA is a technology company founded on the belief that AI has the potential to improve human lives in a variety of ways and across a wide range of applications. They aim to work in collaboration with humans to achieve a future that is more productive, safe, and economically prosperous. Their founding principles revolve around making AI technology accessible and customizable for a range of users, including students, startups, corporations, multinational organizations, and governments around the world. Their objective is to provide a platform for individuals and enterprises to fully leverage the benefits of AI technology.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $100,000, or 50% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $843,304 to $2,055,647, a 2.44x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
